_note: One placeholder line per villager standing in the Hollow Eve maze (note 82). Draft for the voice sheets.

lines.cuthbert: Mind the hedges, friend. I only keep the gate.
lines.odette: Gourd lamps, two hundred. They glow better than candles.
lines.hester: I will sit by the fire a little. My knees do not like mazes.
lines.fitch: I am not scared. I am just standing very still.
lines.wren: The scarecrow looked at me. Looked, I tell you.
lines.toby: I counted the lanterns. There are lots.
lines.pim: Is the chest real? Nobody will say.
lines.hattie: Oh! You startled me. I thought you were the ghost.
lines.podge: I came in for the chestnuts. There are none. Rotten luck.
lines.linnet: Shh. I am hiding from my own brother.
lines.thistle: A niche in the hedge, and I fit it exactly. Lovely.
lines.dorrie: I tried to count the turns and lost my place.
lines.alder: It is only straw and gourds. I keep telling myself that.
lines.tilda: The lanterns look splendid from in here.
lines.rufus: Take the long way. The short way is a rumour.
lines.cordelia: Was that you rustling? I nearly dropped my lantern.
lines.barnaby: Go on ahead. I will guard this corner.
lines.bramwell: The hedge was trimmed fine this year. Bit too fine, for a maze.
lines.walter: I was told there would be a prize at the end. I mean to see it.
lines.aurelle: I love the dark in here. Do not tell the others.
lines.dunmar: I took a wrong turn an hour ago. It was a good turn.
lines.aldreth: Many hedges, many turns. I have been here before, I think.
